 :GLOBAL.warehouse,

 begin

 --
 -- Split components cannot be converted
 --
 select component_prefix into temp_component_prefix
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 product_code = :old_product_code;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205',' Loc-A');
 check_package_failure;

 then

 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :s_chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;

 check_package_Failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- A component already pooled or relabeled cannot
 -- be converted simply because it does not exist
 -- anymore
 --

 select distinct a.product_code, product_desc,
 bag_id
 into :old_product_code, :s_old_desc,
 :GLOBAL.old_bag_id
 from components a, valid_products b
 where a.unit_id = :unit_id and
 a.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 a.coll_date = :coll_date and
 a.product_code = :old_product_code and
 a.component_status = 'L' and
 a.reject_reason_code is null and
 a.warehouse_id=:global.warehouse and 
 SUBSTR(a.product_code,1,5) = b.product_code and -- MODIFIED BY HCL 
 b.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and 
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'));
 exception

 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205',' Loc-B');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin

 select nvl(sum(nvl(bags_for_components,0) - nvl(bags_used,0)), 0) 
 into temp_count
 from component_spiking
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 product_code = :old_product_code and
 component_prefix = temp_component_prefix and
 process_code = :process_code;
 if temp_count <= 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :s_chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0118');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0076');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 P_CHAPTER_ID IN VARCHAR2,

 LV_ATTR_CODE MASTER_CODES.CODE_DESC%TYPE;
 LV_INTER_CODE VALID_ATTRIBUTES.INTER_CODE%TYPE;
 LV_DESC_STR VARCHAR2(200);
 nExists number(10);
 COMMA_POS NUMBER(10);

 lv_inter_exists number(10):= 0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 v_sysdate date;

/* CURSOR get_attr(p_local_date in date) is
 SELECT UPPER(CODE_DESC) code_desc
 FROM MASTER_CODES M
 WHERE CODE = P_ATTR_CODE
 AND CODE_TYPE = 'SPATR'
 AND p_local_date between eff_Date and nvl(term_date, p_local_date+1); 
 */
 

CURSOR get_attr(p_local_date in date) is
 SELECT UPPER(CODE) attr_code
 FROM MASTER_CODES M
 WHERE (CODE = P_ATTR_CODE OR INSTR(CODE_DESC, P_ATTR_CODE,1)>0 )
 AND CODE_TYPE = 'SPATR'
 AND p_local_date between eff_Date and nvl(term_date, p_local_date+1); 

 
BEGIN
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR 
HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 /* check if the attribute being added is defined under the SPARTR in master code*/
for attr_rec in get_attr(v_sysdate) loop 
 /* if attribute exists then continue else exit*/
 /* chk if attribute is valid and has an interdiction associated with it*/
 
 LV_DESC_STR := attr_rec.attr_code;
 
 LOOP
 EXIT WHEN LV_DESC_STR IS NULL;
 comma_pos := instr(LV_DESC_STR, ',');
 IF comma_pos = 0 then --There is only one attribute associated.
 LV_ATTR_CODE := LV_DESC_STR;
 ELSE
 LV_ATTR_CODE := substr(LV_DESC_STR, 1,(comma_pos-1));
 END IF; 
 
 begin -- for attribute check
 select INTER_CODE, ATTRIB_GROUP into lv_inter_code, lv_attrib_group
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_code = LV_ATTR_CODE
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I' 
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_sysdate);
 
 --if attribute exists and is effective then chk if attribute already exits in table
 --else insert into components_attr 

 DECLARE
 dummy varchar2(1);
 lv_count number(10):= 0;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(1) INTO lv_count
 FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND coll_date = p_coll_date
 AND chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND product_code = p_product_code 
 --AND attrib_group = 'SPATR'
 AND attrib_code = LV_ATTR_CODE;
 
 
 IF lv_count = 0 then 
 INSERT INTO COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES
 (UNIT_ID 
 ,COLL_DATE 
 ,CHAPTER_ID 
 ,PRODUCT_CODE 
 ,ATTRIB_GROUP 
 ,ATTRIB_CODE 
 ,INSERT_DATS 
 ,INSERT_USER_ID 
 ,AUDIT_KEY 
 ,PROGRAM_ID 
 ,PROC_DATE)
 VALUES(P_UNIT_ID
 ,P_COLL_DATE
 , P_CHAPTER_ID
 ,P_PRODUCT_CODE
 ,lv_attrib_group
 ,LV_ATTR_CODE
 ,SYSDATE
 ,P_USER_ID
 ,AUDIT_SEQ.NEXTVAL -- AUDIT KEY
 ,P_PROGRAM_ID
 ,P_PROC_DATE
 );
 
 End if;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others then 
 handle_error;
 END;

 IF lv_inter_code is not null then 
 Begin
 
 --chk if inter is effective 
 
 select count(1) into lv_inter_exists
 from valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where vi.inter_code = lv_inter_code
 and v_sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date, v_sysdate);
 
 IF lv_inter_exists > 0 then --inter is effective
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nExists 
 from component_interdictions 
 where unit_id=P_UNIT_ID
 and product_code = P_PRODUCT_CODE
 and inter_code=LV_INTER_CODE ;
 
 If nExists = 0 then --comp inter
 
 --insert into component_interdictions
 INSERT INTO COMPONENT_INTERDICTIONS ( 
 UNIT_ID
 , COLL_DATE
 , CHAPTER_ID
 , PRODUCT_CODE
 , INTER_CODE
 , INSERT_DATS
 , INTER_USER_ID
 , AUDIT_KEY
 , PROGRAM_ID ) 
 VALUES (P_UNIT_ID
 ,P_COLL_DATE
 ,P_CHAPTER_ID
 ,P_PRODUCT_CODE
 ,LV_INTER_CODE
 ,sysdate
 ,P_USER_ID
 ,AUDIT_SEQ.NEXTVAL --AUDIT KEY
 ,P_PROGRAM_ID);
 
 End if; --chk for inter exists already 
 
 END IF; ----inter is effective
 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 END IF;
 
--COMMIT;

 -- Strip out the first attrib code from the string

 If comma_pos = 0 then
 LV_DESC_STR := null;
 Else
 LV_DESC_STR := substr(LV_DESC_STR, (comma_pos+1));--if only one attribute it will assign a null to the variable
 End if;

 Exception -- for attribute chk
 when no_data_found then

End Loop;
 
EXCEPTION
